description: This file contains unit tests for shared utility functions related to daemon container management and runtime status coloring within a CLI tool, utilizing the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeStatusColor
methods.description: Maps runtime states such as 'running', 'stopped', 'unknown', and others to corresponding theme color constants.

methods.name: renderGatewayServiceStartHints
methods.description: Generates hints for starting the gateway service based on environment variables indicating container context.

methods.name: resolveDaemonContainerContext
methods.description: Resolves the daemon container context from environment variables.

methods.name: filterContainerGenericHints
methods.description: Filters out generic hints based on container environment variables.
